Name: Sanji NPC Marriage Candidate
Author: thislegisstupid
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Sanji is now a cook at the saloon. Flirting with women, terrorizing people, and giving out way too much food. This is just a fun little project I put together for me and my sisters...but I thought I'd publish it here too in case someone else would find it as enjoyable as I have.

Since it was for us girls originally, any guys will have to use their imagination. You can still play it, but he will call you a pretty lady...Sorry!
But maybe it's not bad to be called a pretty lady by a cute cook sometimes so idk maybe I'm not sorry. [/color]
